I visited this clinic today because I was experiencing severe wisdom tooth pain. I came hoping to receive a proper consultation and explanation before making any treatment decisions.

An X-ray was taken, but I was disappointed with the overall experience. The dentist immediately focused on extracting my tooth without taking the time to explain my condition, why the extraction was necessary, or what the procedure would involve. As someone with a very strong fear of dental procedures due to a previous difficult wisdom tooth extraction, I expected more communication and reassurance.

I understand that my wisdom tooth probably needs to be removed. I was not refusing treatment I simply wanted to understand my condition and feel mentally prepared before proceeding. Instead, I felt pressured to have the extraction immediately.

Good dental care is not only about performing procedures but also about listening to patients, explaining treatment plans, and helping anxious patients feel safe. Unfortunately, I did not feel heard or supported during my visit, and I left feeling more anxious than when I arrived.

I hope the clinic will improve its communication and patient care, especially for those who suffer from dental anxiety.
